skill.name: deploying-cloud-k8s
skill.description: Guides application deployments to AKS, GKE, and DOKS with Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, GitOps, observability, security, and troubleshooting patterns.
skill.summary: Plan, deploy, and troubleshoot production applications on managed Kubernetes.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown code formatting, placeholders, or standard Kubernetes configuration. Confirmed risks involve an unpinned remote manifest, command-line database secrets, and predictable temporary files. Additional concerns include mutable CI actions, disabled image provenance, and broad access to Kubernetes Secrets.

remediation.issue: A database connection string is expanded into a Helm command argument.
remediation.suggestion: Reference a pre-created Kubernetes Secret from the chart instead of passing secret values through command arguments.

remediation.issue: Application RBAC permits listing every Secret in the namespace.
remediation.suggestion: Grant only required verbs and restrict Secret access with resourceNames or a dedicated service account.

remediation.issue: GitHub Actions use mutable major-version tags.
remediation.suggestion: Pin every third-party action to a reviewed commit SHA and use dependency tooling for controlled updates.

remediation.issue: Docker image provenance is disabled in deployment examples.
remediation.suggestion: Keep provenance enabled and solve platform compatibility through explicit image outputs, manifests, and tested Buildx settings.

remediation.issue: A predictable file is written under the shared temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Create the file with mktemp, set restrictive permissions, and remove it with a cleanup trap.

remediation.issue: An Argo CD installation manifest is applied from a mutable stable branch.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the manifest to a reviewed release or commit and verify its checksum before applying it.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad Kubernetes Secret RBAC
semantic_findings.description: The sample Role grants get and list access to every Secret in the namespace. A compromised application could enumerate unrelated credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The Role explicitly includes secrets with get and list verbs and no resourceNames restriction. This directly expands credential exposure.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable GitHub Actions Dependencies
semantic_findings.description: CI examples reference actions by mutable major tags. A moved or compromised tag could execute changed code with workflow credentials.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Each uses entry ends in a major-version tag instead of an immutable commit SHA. This is a recognized CI supply-chain risk.

semantic_findings.title: Container Image Provenance Disabled
semantic_findings.description: The guidance repeatedly disables Buildx provenance. This removes attestations that can support image origin and build verification.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setting is explicitly recommended and added to the deployment checklist. Its documented purpose confirms intentional attestation removal.

content.value_statement: Production Kubernetes deployments often fail because images, variables, pipelines, and clusters use incompatible settings. This skill provides practical deployment, GitOps, security, observability, and troubleshooting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Distinguishes Next.js build-time variables from Kubernetes runtime configuration.
Guides cluster architecture detection and matching Docker build platforms.
Provides GitHub Actions patterns for selective builds and Helm deployments.
Supplies Kubernetes commands for pod, event, image, and application log diagnosis.
Explains Argo CD, Kustomize, Prometheus, autoscaling, probes, and disruption budgets.
Provides examples for security contexts, NetworkPolicies, RBAC, and external secrets.
limitations: The skill does not authenticate to cloud providers or provision managed clusters.
All example names, domains, namespaces, platforms, and resource values require project-specific review.
Cloud IAM, billing, registry creation, and provider-specific networking are outside its detailed scope.
Several secret-handling and supply-chain examples require security hardening before production use.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Managed Deployment
use_cases.description: Create a deployment checklist covering image architecture, build variables, Helm values, namespaces, and basic runtime validation.

use_cases.title: Build a Selective Delivery Pipeline
use_cases.description: Plan GitHub Actions jobs that build changed services, publish matching images, and deploy reviewed Helm releases.

use_cases.title: Stabilize a Production Cluster
use_cases.description: Review GitOps, observability, RBAC, pod security, autoscaling, probes, and disruption controls for an existing workload.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Deployment Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deployment checklist for my application on [AKS, GKE, or DOKS]. Include architecture, variables, images, Helm, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Failed Pod
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this Kubernetes pod failure: [status and logs]. Rank likely causes, request missing evidence, and provide safe verification steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a CI/CD Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GitHub Actions and Helm workflow for [repository structure]. Include path filters, architecture matching, secret references, approvals, and rollback checks.

prompt_templates.title: Review Production Kubernetes Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my deployment approach for GitOps, immutable dependencies, least-privilege RBAC, image provenance, observability, resilience, secret handling, and recovery. Prioritize risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Platform engineer conducting an advanced production review

output_examples.input: The pod reports ImagePullBackOff after a new release.
output: First compare the deployed image tag with the registry tag.
Then verify registry credentials and the image repository path.
Finally inspect events for architecture or manifest compatibility errors.

output_examples.input: Plan a Next.js deployment with separate browser and server configuration.
output: Classify public browser variables as image build inputs.
Keep database and authentication values in managed runtime secrets.
Validate redirect URLs and internal service names after deployment.

output_examples.input: Review a production workload for resilience.
output: Set realistic resource requests before configuring autoscaling.
Add startup, readiness, and liveness probes with distinct purposes.
Use multiple replicas and a disruption budget for planned maintenance.

best_practices: Confirm node architecture before selecting a Docker build platform.
Pin remote manifests and CI actions to reviewed immutable versions.
Reference managed secrets without placing secret values in command arguments.
anti_patterns: Do not treat public build variables and runtime secrets as interchangeable.
Do not deploy mutable tags or remote manifests without review and verification.
Do not grant applications broad namespace access to Kubernetes Secrets.

faq.question: Which managed Kubernetes services does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It targets common deployment patterns for AKS, GKE, and DOKS. Most guidance also applies to other conformant Kubernetes services.

faq.question: Can this skill create my cloud cluster?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on application delivery and operations after cluster access exists.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete production pipeline?
faq.answer: It can help design one, but repository layout, credentials, approval rules, and provider settings still require project-specific decisions.

faq.question: How does it handle Next.js public variables?
faq.answer: It treats NEXT_PUBLIC variables as build-time inputs because Next.js embeds them in browser bundles.

faq.question: Can it troubleshoot failed deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers image pulls, architecture mismatches, crash loops, pending pods, logs, events, Helm parsing, and redirect problems.

faq.question: Is every included example production-ready?
faq.answer: No. Replace placeholders and harden dependency pinning, secret delivery, temporary files, RBAC, and provenance settings before production use.
